description.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  description: About this project.
```

An optional page-specific description rendered as `<meta name="description">`. It is not visible in page content.

[Page title and frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/content.md#page-title-and-frontmatter)

aliases.description: Previous site-relative URLs that permanently identify this page. The current page is always the target.

items.description: Previous site-relative URL that permanently identifies this page.
items.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  aliases:
    - /old-about/
```

Use a previous Norna page URL. Start and end with `/`; use lowercase ASCII letters, numbers, and single hyphens; do not include the configured base path, a query string, or a fragment.

[Alias path rules](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/pages.md#preserve-old-page-urls)

aliases.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  aliases:
    - /old-about/
```

Lists previous site-relative URLs that permanently identify this page. The page containing the list is always the target. Paths omit the configured base path and are excluded from the sitemap.

[Preserve old page URLs](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/pages.md#preserve-old-page-urls)

page.description: Optional metadata for this homepage or additional page. The Markdown H1 supplies the page title.
page.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  description: About this project.
  aliases:
    - /old-about/
```

Contains optional metadata for the current homepage or additional page. The Markdown H1 supplies its title. An alias records an old URL for this same page.

[Page title and frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/content.md#page-title-and-frontmatter)

navigation.description: Optional navigation metadata for this page.

listed.description: List this page in site navigation. The page remains public when false.
listed.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  listed: false
```

List this page in site navigation. The page remains public when false.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/pages.md#navigation)

navigation.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  listed: false
```

Optionally excludes an additional page from site navigation without removing its public URL.

[Site navigation reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/pages.md#navigation)

description: Frontmatter for a homepage or additional page content.md file.
title: Norna page frontmatter
markdownDescription:
```yaml
---
page:
  description: About this project.
---
```

Content frontmatter is optional. Write the page title as the single Markdown H1; use frontmatter only for optional metadata or navigation settings.

[Page title and frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.22/docs/content.md#page-title-and-frontmatter)
